items.title: Taxing all 938 billionaires at 100% wouldn’t stop the $40 trillion national debt, says Elon Musk. Bernie Sanders says tax them 5% and send you a check

items.summaryZh: 埃隆·马斯克认为，美国40万亿美元的债务太大，亿万富翁税无法解决，但伯尼·桑德斯表示，5%的税至少可以让3000美元回到你的口袋里。

items.title: Women want ‘dads,’ not ‘duds’: A Nobel-winning historian has a theory for falling birthrates, but the economics aren’t so straightforward
items.summary: "The more that men can credibly signal they will be dependable ' dads' and not disappointing 'duds,' the more investment in women’s education and careers, and the higher will be the birthrate in the face of greater female agency."
items.titleZh: 女人想要“爸爸”，而不是“帅哥”：一位诺贝尔奖获得者历史学家对出生率下降有一个理论，但经济学并不那么简单
items.summaryZh: “男性越能可靠地表明他们将成为可靠的‘爸爸’，而不是令人失望的‘哑巴’，对女性教育和职业的投资就越多，面对更大的女性能动性，出生率就越高。”
